## Survey open-0: LIN-4464 @ 5dcf5bcda

Base: origin/main `5dcf5bcda` (the #2424 merge). The kit's snippet was run unchanged.

**Why this will be harder than "rerun #2422"**

1. **The kit can't be used fully unchanged.** `area-read.md` names Runs as the work area, posts to LIN-4447 with `@ 4b5001ddf` headings, and writes the verdict as D = Δ(Runs) − Δ(control). The salt and N=14 carry over. The area, base, target ticket and verdict wording still have to be set somewhere, and editing the kit breaks its blob pin for LIN-4462's after-read. Put them in an adoption block in each report's header and leave the kit's file alone.

2. **The pairing isn't balanced the way the kit claims.** The kit chose N=14 for a 3.4% byte gap between Runs and the control. Here the samples are **380,459 B** for llm-and-prompts (14 of 91 files) and **206,545 B** for the control (14 of 92), a gap of about 84%. `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (120,531) and `lib/openrouter.js` (103,188) are 59% of the LLM sample, so K3/K4 will mostly score those two files. Each pass also takes about 395 KB inline (sample plus the 14,838 B note). The noise guard (≥1.0 apart) is more likely to trip. Record this as a known limit and keep N. The upside: all three planned files are in the sample (`openrouter`, `prompt-template-defs`, `recommendation-live-wait`), so unlike Runs, this read does see the work.

3. **There is more contamination of the control than the ticket says.** Three of the 14 control files changed between `4b5001ddf` and the base:
   - `render-proxy.js` (812d9adbb, #2424), as noted;
   - `render-swipe.js` and `render-task-page.js`, from **#2423 (LIN-4446)**, which the ticket doesn't mention. `render-task-page.js` is also one of LIN-4453's four tracked files.

   The control's **note** changed too: `front-end-pages.md` went from 6,404 B to 5,825 B (blob `ae9c007e1`), and its Waiting entries from 14 to 12. Both reads sit at `5dcf5bcda`, so the pair holds. Record all of it; this control read's M scores won't match LIN-4453's.

4. **Other numbers have moved.** `areas.json` is now `1dc2ba701`, with no change to either sample. The LLM note is blob `b6b4c726d` with **25** Waiting entries, not the parent's 26 (#2421 removed one).

5. **Open PRs.** #2427 and #2426 touch neither sample. I checked every open PR: none touches the 28 files. Write them as `#NNNN`, never as full URLs: the kit warns that `landingPrUrls` would pull a PR URL into the landing.

**Smaller traps**
- "Frozen prompt" in the acceptance means the reader prompt, not the parent's 378,915 B prompt budget.
- The reader prompt's K2 examples are about Runs. Δ is still sound, but don't compare absolute scores across areas.
- Commit the reports as `area-read-reports/{llm-and-prompts,front-end-pages}-5dcf5bcda.md`. If you also post them as comments, use the `## Area read:` heading, not `## Blind read` (422).

**What I'd do first:** fix the base at `5dcf5bcda` even if main moves, provided none of pieces 1–6 has landed. Then write the adoption block (area, base, target LIN-4448, verdict mapping, byte-imbalance limit, the full contamination list) before running any reader. Then do four fresh passes.

## Survey global: LIN-4464 @ e8e92d50a

Base `e8e92d50a` is #2426's (LIN-4456) own merge, after `5dcf5bcda`. Kit and prompt blobs are unchanged (`cbec2d848`, `ef1c2ca91`). `areas.json` is `1dc2ba701`.

**Where it lands.** In `docs/plans/survey/`: the kit, the method-as-run addendum and `area-read-reports/`. The kit is frozen, but it is written as a one-off. Its table, its headings (`@ 4b5001ddf`, "comment on LIN-4447"), its verdict (Δ Runs − Δ control) and its Known limits all name Runs. Only the snippet and the prompt take parameters. This is its second use.

**Done the obvious way**, the task copies `area-read-method-as-run.md` and swaps "Runs" for "LLM". That leaves a second copy of the method, beside a kit whose words don't fit this read. The reports also have to record what the kit gets wrong here:

- **Bytes are out of balance.** The snippet gives LLM 91 files, 14 sampled, **380,459 bytes**. The control has 206,545 (1.84×). N = 14 was picked to balance against Runs. Here `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (120,531) and `lib/openrouter.js` (103,188) make up 59% of the sample, and the reader bundle is about 395 KB, nearly twice the size that forced the file-path delivery. N is frozen, so record the gap; don't fix it.
- **The Known limits flip.** All three planned files are sampled (ranks 1, 5, 8). The read is sensitive to the work, but it mostly measures two files. Copying kit limits 1–2 would state the opposite of what is true.
- **The control moved more than the ticket says.** Since `4b5001ddf`, #2424 changed `lib/render-proxy.js`, and #2423 (LIN-4446) changed `lib/render-swipe.js` and `lib/render-task-page.js`. The control note shrank from 6,404 to 5,825 bytes. All of it falls inside this baseline. Because the salt is unchanged, the control paths match LIN-4453's, so this read is a free midpoint for it. Note that; don't claim it.
- **Control files the work imports.** Six unsampled front-end files import `lib/openrouter.js`, which piece 1 changes: `render-settings-models`, `render-roadmap`, `components/model-change-lines`, `render-settings`, `render-landing`, `components/decision-panel`. Record their blobs, as the kit does for its four.
- **Open PRs.** #2426 has merged (it is the base). #2427 and the eleven other open PRs touch neither sample.
- **The prompt's K2 examples are about Runs** (close-out, PRs per task, dispatch model). They are frozen; note it.

Something would notice if this went wrong. A report posted as a comment that names a full PR URL joins the ticket's landing, because `landingPrUrls` skips only blind reads and survey reports (Runs Waiting, LIN-4453 leftover). Write `#2427`.

**Better, at this task's cost.** One short addendum that cites the kit by blob and lists only what differs: base, area, byte gap, flipped limits, the six-file import table, and the control's three moved files. Full recorded fields go in each report, as in #2422, named `<slug>-e8e92d50a.md`.

**Better still, not this task's.** A parameterised kit under a new name, with base, area, N and salt as inputs and a per-read limits section, so the third read needs no third addendum. And an area-read kind in the comment classifier (LIN-4458).

## LIN-4464 done: baseline area read at e8e92d50a

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2430 (head `ce6cb88aa`), docs only.

**Result.** Both areas read at `e8e92d50a` with the frozen kit (blob `cbec2d848`) and reader prompt (blob `ef1c2ca91`), two fresh passes each.
- LLM & prompts: code 3.3 (passes 3.3 / 3.3), note 3.25 (3.0 / 3.5)
- Front end: server-rendered pages (control): code 3.3 (3.3 / 3.3), note 3.5 (3.5 / 3.5)
- Noise guard not fired on either area.

**Recorded limits.** LLM sample 380,459 B against control 206,545 B (1.84x; N kept at 14). `lib/openrouter.js` and `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` are 59% of the LLM sample. Control files moved since `4b5001ddf` (`render-proxy`, `render-swipe`, `render-task-page`), flagged for the after-read.

**Open PRs.** Fourteen open; none touches a sampled file. #2427 adds 5 lines to the LLM note, outside the baseline.

**Contamination.** Every counted reader read only its own bundle, except one Bash `grep` of its own header lines by a Front-end pass. Recorded in the control report; the pass is counted.

**Retires.** No Waiting entry. Fills the missing-baseline gap. Nothing from pieces 1–6 on main.

**CI.** `CI success` (ci-success) pass, and all seven jobs pass: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source).

**Decisions made:**
- Base `e8e92d50a`, as the brief asks, so both reads share one commit.
- Area names in `{AREA}` are the `areas.json` names. Nothing else in the reader prompt changed.
- N kept at 14 despite the byte imbalance.

Reports: `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/llm-and-prompts-e8e92d50a.md`, `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/front-end-pages-e8e92d50a.md`. Adoption record: `docs/plans/survey/area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md`.

### Leftovers
- Tidied: `docs/plans/survey/area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md` quoted the kit's Lessons figures (1,012 and 4,257 B) beside the LLM and control notes, so 4,257 B read as an LLM figure. It is the Runs note's, at `4b5001ddf`. The line now says which pair the figures belong to (`444b58246`).
- Summary comment, for John: the area-read method is now spelled across three files: the frozen kit `docs/plans/survey/area-read.md`, `docs/plans/survey/area-read-method-as-run.md` and `docs/plans/survey/area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md`. A third read would need a third addendum. These are unmapped `docs/plans/` files with no code file to cite, so no area note can hold this. A kit that takes base, area, N and salt as inputs would fix it, as the Survey global on this ticket said; it is outside this task.

No lesson added to either note. `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` is the baseline's measured note (blob `b6b4c726d`) and `docs/areas/front-end-pages.md` is the control's, so an edit to either would move the note blob the reports pin.

Retires: none, no waiting entry. The PR touches only unmapped `docs/plans/survey/` files. The ask says this piece retires no Waiting entry. Settling an LLM & prompts entry would land piece 1–6 work before the baseline merges, and settling a front-end-pages entry would move the control.

## Review — LIN-4464

PR #2430, head `444b58246f37ce4796b181e9b0e21843fce29eee` (2 commits on `e8e92d50a`; adds 3 files, all under `docs/plans/survey/`, all docs).

CI: green on head `444b58246`. `CI success` and all seven jobs pass (Unit, Unit proxy +400d, E2E 1–4, Secret scan). The PR is MERGEABLE.

### What I checked again myself
- **Frozen kit.** At `e8e92d50a` and at current main, `area-read.md` is blob `cbec2d848` and `area-read-reader-prompt.md` is blob `ef1c2ca91`. The PR edits neither file. The differences for this read sit in a separate addendum, `area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md`.
- **Samples.** I ran the kit's snippet unchanged at `e8e92d50a`. llm-and-prompts: 91 files, 14 picked, 380,459 B. front-end-pages: 92 files, 14 picked, 206,545 B. Both lists match the reports path for path and byte for byte. `lib/openrouter.js` (rank 1), `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (rank 5) and `lib/recommendation-live-wait.js` (rank 8) are in the sample, as the ask expects.
- **Recorded blobs.** The notes match the reports: `b6b4c726d` (LLM) and `ae9c007e1` (control). `areas.json` is `1dc2ba701`. The control-movement table checks out: `render-proxy` `1163626c3→b66ee3624`, `render-swipe` `32aefe9f0→c8b9e1744`, `render-task-page` `e5e1626cc→06654bb14`.
- **Importers of `lib/openrouter.js` in the control.** The six unsampled files plus `render-settings-you` are the complete set. `render-pages.js` and `settings-areas.js` only mention `/auth/openrouter` routes in strings and don't import the module.
- **Pieces 1–6 (LIN-4465…4470).** None of them has a commit on `origin/main`. None of the 28 sampled files changed between `e8e92d50a` and current main.
- **Regression check.** All three files are new; `git log` on those paths is empty. Nothing in the PR was reverted earlier or fixed before.
- **Area notes.** The PR paths are unmapped in `areas.json`. None of the `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` Lessons covers a docs-only survey record. The builder rightly left both measured notes unedited, since an edit would move the blobs the reports pin.
- **Rulings.** None exist for LIN-4464 (`includeResolved=true`). I raise no `DECISION:`.

### Against the `## As asked` block, sentence by sentence
1. *Baseline read for `llm-and-prompts` before any other piece, with a fresh control read at the same commit.* **Met.** Both areas are read at `e8e92d50a`, and no piece has landed.
2. *Use the LIN-4453 kit and frozen prompt unchanged, with #2422 as the model.* **Met.** The blobs are unchanged and the adoption addendum holds the differences. The report layout mirrors #2422.
3. *One base commit, recorded in each report. The old table can't be reused.* **Met.** `e8e92d50a` appears in both reports' Recorded fields, and both samples were re-drawn.
4. *Control contamination from #2424. Take the base at or after `5dcf5bcda` and record it.* **Met.** `e8e92d50a` comes after `5dcf5bcda`, and the record goes further: #2423's two files and the control note's change are recorded too.
5. *List the open PRs touching either sample, check #2427 and #2426, and record the hash sample including the three planned files.* **Met.** The reports list 14 open PRs and record that none touches a sample. #2426 is the base itself, and #2427 touches the LLM note only. The sample tables carry blobs. The list goes stale at merge; see ledger item 2.
6. *Testing: the kit's own checks. Docs-only PR.* **Met.** Noise guard, contamination check and blob pins are all done, and the PR is docs only.
7. *Acceptance: two reports at the same base, made with the frozen prompt.* **Met.**
8. *Acceptance: the contamination notes and the open-PR list are in both reports.* **Met in part.** The open-PR list is in both. The LLM report only says the control "moved" and points to the other files. It doesn't name #2424, #2423 or the three files. Fix 1 closes that gap.
9. *Acceptance: nothing from pieces 1–6 lands before this merges.* **True now.** It has to hold until the merge; see ledger item 1.
10. *Retires: no Waiting entry.* **Met.** The Leftovers `Retires:` line says none and explains why. The diff removes no entry, which matches.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is how the area-read method is written down. Two reads have now been done, and the method lives in three files: the kit, `area-read-method-as-run.md` and `area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md`. This is **outside** the ticket. The ask holds the kit frozen, and the Survey global ruled a reusable kit out of this task. It breaks nothing today, so it is not a ticket. The builder's Leftovers already put it in the summary comment for John, because these paths map to no area note. I agree with that. Apart from this, the change is isolated.

### Test quality
This is a docs-only record, so there is no code path to mutation-check. The evidence that counts is that the numbers can be reproduced: the samples, byte totals and blobs. I re-ran all of those myself, and they match.

### Fixes for close-out (make before merging)
1. **`docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/llm-and-prompts-e8e92d50a.md`, section `## Control and contamination`, bullet "Control moved."** Name the moves the bullet refers to: `lib/render-proxy.js` (#2424, LIN-4457), and `lib/render-swipe.js` and `lib/render-task-page.js` (#2423, LIN-4446). Also name the control note going from `971d4bf6c` to `ae9c007e1` (12 Waiting entries, down from 14). Keep the pointer to the addendum. This meets acceptance sentence 8 word for word.
2. **The "when checked" statements are now stale.** Both reports and the addendum (sections 1, 3 and 4) say nothing is after `e8e92d50a` on main and that #2427 is open. Since then, #2427 (LIN-4455, merge `192e1f81f`) and #2428 (LIN-4456, `0092d8d9e`) have merged. Leave the "when checked" wording as it is. Add one dated "At merge" line to addendum section 3, and the same line to the `Open PRs` bullet in the LLM report. The line should say:
   - #2427 has merged, so the LLM note on main is now blob `eb976276d` (+5 lines) while the baseline stays `b6b4c726d`. The after-read reports that difference as note movement.
   - #2428 touched neither note nor any sampled file.
   - No sampled file changed between `e8e92d50a` and the merge commit.

   Re-check those facts at the moment of merging.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (acceptance sentence 9, "nothing from pieces 1–6 has landed before this merges"). **Before the merge:** right before merging, `git log origin/main --oneline -E --grep='LIN-44(6[5-9]|70)'` is empty, and `git diff --name-only e8e92d50a origin/main` meets none of the 28 sampled paths. Either one being non-empty means the baseline is no longer "before". Stop and raise it on LIN-4448.
- **Inside** (acceptance sentence 5/8, the open-PR and contamination record). The record must be accurate when it merges. **Before the merge:** make fixes 1 and 2, re-running `gh pr list --state open` and checking each PR's file list against the 28 paths and both notes.
- **Inside** (acceptance sentence 7, "made with the frozen prompt"). The reader transcripts aren't committed, so CI can't show that the four passes got exactly the frozen prompt with only `{AREA}` filled, or that the tool-call check was right. Review can't re-run them either, since a fresh pass is a new read and not a reproduction. This matches #2422's precedent: the reports are the record. **Discharged** as recorded: the builder's contamination tables and the verbatim pass outputs are in both reports.
- **Inside** (frozen method's clean-pass check). Front-end Pass B made one Bash `grep -n "^=== "` on its own inputs file. The as-run addendum's check lists Bash as not allowed. The report records the deviation openly. The grep read nothing outside the bundle, and Pass B's scores equal Pass A's (3.3 / 3.5), so leaving it out would not change the control's baseline. **Discharged** as recorded; I agree with counting it. The after-read should keep readers to Read only, as the report already says.
- **Inside** (known limit carried from #2422). Readers may have loaded the repository's `CLAUDE.md` into context before their first tool call, and the tool-call check can't see that. **Discharged** as recorded in the addendum's section 5. It affects the before and after reads alike, so Δ survives it.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

Close-out makes fixes 1 and 2 on the PR branch, runs the pre-merge check for pieces 1–6 and the sampled paths, and confirms `ci-success` is green on the final commit before merging. Next action: `close-out`.

## Blind read
Verdict: worse. It simplifies the held-wake release in `lib/dispatch-store.js`: `setHeldWakeReleaseNote`, `_releaseNoteFor` and `UNBOUND_HELD_WAKE_RELEASE_NOTE` are gone, so there is one wording path instead of two. It also drops the always-true `mayCarryWake` filter from `findWakeEvent` (`lib/dispatch-terminal.js`). Against that, it deletes the one-owner declarations `lib/dispatch-feedback-kinds.js` and `NEVER_RAN`, and copies those values back out into about ten files across runs-and-dispatch and agent-api, with nothing checking they stay in step. The store also takes back the leftover wording through `formatHeldWakeNote`.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2430 at `444b58246` against `0092d8d9e`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `lib/dispatch-leftover.js` (runs-and-dispatch): it spells out two rules that already have an owner. `RESUMABLE_TARGETS = new Set(['cli','web'])` with `doc.target || 'cli'` repeats `followUpTarget` (`lib/dispatch-targets.js`, whose header names it the one follow-up target rule, LIN-3672). `halt?.mode === 'pause' || halt?.mode === 'stop'` repeats `HALT_MODES` (`lib/workspace-halt.js`). Fix: import `followUpTarget` and `HALT_MODES` again and drop the local copies. That is two lines in one file and changes no behaviour.
- `tests/unit/decision-lifecycle-stamp-drift.test.js` (runs-and-dispatch, concerns `lib/digest-feedback.js`): `lib/run-view.js` now carries its own copy of the three stamp kinds (`DECISION_STAMP_KINDS`). That copy is not in the test's `sites` list, and the docblock's count ("4 literal copies across 5 call sites") leaves it out, so this copy can drift with no alarm. Fix: add `lib/run-view.js` to `sites` and update the count in the docblock. A related tidy-up in `lib/run-view.js`: the "A wake marker is a leading prefix…" comment now sits on its own between the set and `lastWakeEntry`'s docblock. Fold it back into that docblock.

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/dispatch-store.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `releaseHeldWake` calls `formatHeldWakeNote({ status })`, which returns "The leftover step did not run…" (`lib/dispatch-wake.js:331`). The store that `tests/unit/lin-4377-store-knows-no-leftover.test.js` says "knows no leftovers" therefore speaks the leftover wording again. That test's docblock still claims "what its wake says, live[s] in the injected hook". The test only counts the word "leftover", so it does not witness that claim, and the dependency check that did witness it was deleted. Larger because someone has to decide who owns the release wording, and that is the design this change took out.
- `lib/dispatch-store.js`, `lib/dispatch-leftover.js`, `lib/dispatch-terminal.js`, `lib/observer-sweep.js`, `lib/task-page-loader.js`, `lib/plan-review-round-trips.js`, `routes/dispatch.js` (runs-and-dispatch): "a row that never ran" (`cancelled`/`expired`) is now written out separately at each site. `dispatch-store.js` does it twice (lines 1176 and 1906), and `dispatch-leftover.js:29` declares a private `NEVER_RAN`. A third archive-without-running status would need every site found by hand. Larger because it needs one owner chosen and imported across areas (see Outside).
- `lib/dispatch-store.js`, `lib/session-telemetry.js`, `lib/digest-feedback.js`, `lib/wall-clock-summary.js`, `lib/run-view.js` (runs-and-dispatch): the feedback-entry kinds have no single declaration again:
  - the runner allowlist is in the store;
  - the relay kinds are in `session-telemetry.js` (`PARKED_WAIT_SKIPPED_KINDS`);
  - the stamp kinds are in four lib copies.

  With the table and its test deleted, a new kind no longer has to say what its roles are. `lib/dispatch-feedback-validation.js` also now imports the whole run store just to read one array. Larger because giving the kinds a home is a design decision.

### Outside the area
- `routes/proxy-dispatch.js` (agent-api): `['queued', 'cancelled', 'expired'].includes(statusFilter)` is another inline copy of the never-ran statuses. It needs to stay in step with the runs-and-dispatch sites above.

### Note on the Blind read above (autopilot, checked against the PR)

The Blind read's "worse" verdict describes changes PR #2430 does not contain, so it does not measure this change.

- PR #2430 at head `444b58246`: 3 files changed, 358 additions, 0 deletions, all under `docs/plans/survey/`.
- Against its own base `e8e92d50a` the head is ahead by 2 and behind by 0.
- The Blind read compared against `0092d8d9e`, a main commit dated 16:19, after the branch point (`e8e92d50a`, 15:59). Against that commit the branch is diverged, behind by 10. The lib/ deletions it lists (`lib/dispatch-feedback-kinds.js`, `NEVER_RAN`, the store's held-wake wording) are work merged to main after this branch, not removed by it.

So the code edits it proposes (`lib/dispatch-leftover.js`, `lib/run-view.js`, the drift test) are not fixes to this PR. This piece is a docs-only baseline and must stay so: any code change here would move the very thing it measures.

This is a measurement note only. The review's verdict and ledger stand as written.

## Close-out — LIN-4464

**Merged:** PR #2430, merge commit `2aab32bf0`, pinned to head `17900065c` with `--match-head-commit`. Docs only: three new files under `docs/plans/survey/` (the `llm-and-prompts` and `front-end-pages` reports at `e8e92d50a`, and the adoption addendum). Review's account of how this meets the ask stands: both areas read at one base with the frozen kit (`cbec2d848`) and reader prompt (`ef1c2ca91`), contamination notes and open-PR list in both reports, no piece 1–6 on main, no Waiting entry retired. This is a docs-only change with no deploy, so there were no post-deploy steps. I checked the landed content on `origin/main`: all three files are present, the diff from `0092d8d9e` is those three files only (367 insertions), and both fixes are in the text.

### Changes I made (review's fixes, on the PR branch)
- `8237ec317`, answers review fix 1: the LLM report's "Control moved" bullet now names `lib/render-proxy.js` (#2424, LIN-4457), `lib/render-swipe.js` and `lib/render-task-page.js` (#2423, LIN-4446), and the control note's move from `971d4bf6c` to `ae9c007e1` (14 to 12 Waiting entries). It keeps the addendum pointer.
- `8237ec317`, answers review fix 2: a dated "At merge (2026-11-13)" line in adoption section 3 and in the LLM report's `Open PRs` bullet. The "when checked" wording is untouched. It records #2427 merged (`192e1f81f`; LLM note `b6b4c726d` to `eb976276d`, +5 lines, so the after-read must report note movement), and #2428 (`0092d8d9e`) touching neither note nor a sampled file.
- `bc89fb61e`: my own wording error ("twelve" other open PRs, should be eleven).
- `17900065c`: the open-PR refresh found two PRs opened after the baseline check, now recorded. **#2432 (LIN-4459) is open and touches the sampled file `lib/openrouter.js` and the LLM note.** It has not merged, so the baseline holds, but if it merges before the after-read, that file's blob and the note move and the after-read must account for both. #2429 (LIN-4451) adds 6 lines to the control note `front-end-pages.md` and is also open. #2431 (LIN-4471) touches neither note nor a sampled file.

No blind-read fixes were applied (see below).

### Ledger
- **Nothing from pieces 1–6 lands before this merges (inside):** immediately before the merge, `git log origin/main --oneline -E --grep='LIN-44(6[5-9]|70)'` was empty. `git diff --name-only e8e92d50a origin/main` (28 files) met none of the 28 sampled paths. I extracted the sample from the reports' rank tables, 28 paths, and compared. Main was `0092d8d9e`.
- **Open-PR and contamination record accurate at merge (inside):** done by fixes 1 and 2 above, with `gh pr list --state open` re-run and every file list checked against the 28 paths and both notes. Re-run again right before the merge: the open set was unchanged from the one recorded.
- **Frozen prompt, tool-call check, Pass B grep, possible `CLAUDE.md` exposure (inside):** discharged as recorded by review. Transcripts are not committed, so they cannot be re-run. The reports are the record, as in #2422.
- **Outside, the method spread over three files:** review judged it outside, not a ticket (it breaks nothing today), and the builder's Leftovers put it in this summary because those paths map to no area note. For John: the area-read method now lives in the frozen kit `docs/plans/survey/area-read.md`, `area-read-method-as-run.md` and `area-read-adoption-e8e92d50a.md`. A third read would need a third addendum. A kit that takes base, area, N and salt as inputs would fix it; it is outside this task. No ticket filed, no Waiting entry written (no area owns these files).
- No named monitor or rollback applied. The ledger had none.

### Blind read
Its "worse" verdict compared the branch with `0092d8d9e`, a later diverged main, so it describes #2427's (LIN-4455) merged code changes, not this docs-only PR (3 files, +358 −0 at `444b58246`). I applied none of its code fixes. Its finds about `lib/dispatch-store.js`, `lib/dispatch-leftover.js` and the feedback-kinds table concern LIN-4455's work and belong to that ticket's own review. I filed nothing from it.

### Final CI
`CI success` and all seven jobs (Unit tests, Unit tests proxy clock +400d, E2E 1–4, Secret scan) green on the final head `17900065c`, run 43465388521. CI exists on this repo, so no substitute was needed.

### Close-out housekeeping
Set to Done. Archive: `GET /issues/LIN-4464/brief?noRefresh=1`, then `/snapshots`, which shows a snapshot (captured 16:32:38) whose description equals the live one. The description holds only the `## As asked` block and `## Size of the move`, with no plan, research or design sections, so there was no discharged artifact to prune. I added a short stub under its own heading and left both existing sections as they were. ## As asked

Piece 0 of LIN-4448's plan. Take the **baseline** area read for `llm-and-prompts` before any other piece lands, together with a fresh read of the control area `front-end-pages` at the same commit.

**Approach (plan, behaviour F/closing line; review note 12)**

* Use the LIN-4453 kit: `docs/plans/survey/area-read.md` and its frozen reader prompt, unchanged. LIN-4453's piece 0 (PR #2422) is the model to follow.
* Read both areas at **one** base commit and record that commit in each report. The kit's fixed table is pinned to `4b5001ddf` and to LIN-4447's areas, so neither the Runs read nor the control read can be reused. This area has no baseline yet.
* Contamination of the control: PR #2424 (LIN-4457) changed two `aria-label`s in `lib/render-proxy.js`, which is in the control's 14-file sample. It merged at `5dcf5bcda`. Take the base at or after that commit so the change sits inside the baseline rather than between the reads, and record it either way.
* List the open PRs that touch either area's sample and record them. At breakdown time these were #2427 (LIN-4455) and #2426 (LIN-4456); check their files against both samples. Record the area's hash sample at the base. It should include `lib/openrouter.js`, `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and `lib/recommendation-live-wait.js`, which pieces 1, 3 and 5 change.

**Testing:** the kit's own checks. Docs-only PR.

**Acceptance**

* Two reports are committed: `llm-and-prompts` and `front-end-pages`, both at the same recorded base commit, made with the frozen prompt.
* The contamination notes and the open-PR list are recorded in both reports.
* Nothing from pieces 1–6 has landed before this merges.

**Retires:** no Waiting entry. It fills the missing-baseline gap the plan names.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4448 (LLM & prompts, left simpler). The full approved plan is the parent's description, section `## Implementation Plan`, and its amendments are in the parent's comment `### Plan Review Verdict` (72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09). The parent's `## As asked` block sets the scope.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4448's approving plan-review (comment 72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** the plan was written at `JKershaw/LinearViewer` main `2bf788b6d` (surveys at `4b5001ddf`) and reviewed at `c205190fd`. The breakdown re-checked at `5dcf5bcda`. The only change since is LIN-4457 (#2424), and the one plan file it touches is the cost-read entry in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course, and say so in a comment on LIN-4448.

**Every PR names what it retires** (the LIN-4414 rule). It edits the Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` that it settles. It respects that note's Lessons and leaves `docs/reviews/` reports unchanged.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Delivers the paired baseline the ask names, both areas at one recorded commit with the frozen kit; no Survey finding binds, since recording the kit's misfits beside it is the ask's own shape and a reusable kit is separate work.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented

PR #2430 merged at `2aab32bf0` (docs only): the paired baseline area reads for `llm-and-prompts` and `front-end-pages` at `e8e92d50a`, with an adoption addendum. Implemented as asked; the one deviation from the ask's wording is that the base is `e8e92d50a` (after `5dcf5bcda`, as the ask allows). The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.
